rightPanel.aboutBody: Coloc Explorer brings together recorded T1D colocalization, GWAS/QTL credible-set membership, and linked PanKgraph evidence.
importantBodyLines: This tool explores existing results; it does not rerun colocalization or fine-mapping.
Support for a shared signal does not prove a causal gene, variant, or mechanism.
Coverage varies by source. Credible-set members do not represent every variant tested in the original analysis.
